question: In which of the following unitary air conditioners, are all components in one unit, like a rooftop package unit?
solution:
The correct answer is __Window air conditioners****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Window air conditioners__ are a type of unitary air conditioner.
 
• All components of the air conditioning system, including the compressor, condenser, and evaporator, are housed in a single unit.
 
• They are typically installed in a window or a specially made wall opening to cool a single room.
 
• Window AC units are compact, easy to install, and commonly used in residential or small-scale commercial spaces.
 
• They provide an economical and practical solution for cooling in spaces where central air conditioning is not feasible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Air Conditioners:**
 
 
• These systems cool an entire building by circulating cool air through a series of ducts.
 
• They have separate indoor and outdoor units.
 
 
 
• **Ducted Split Systems:**
 
 
• These systems consist of an outdoor unit connected to multiple indoor units via ductwork.
 
• They provide zoned cooling and heating options.
 
 
 
• **Ductless Systems:**
 
 
• These systems are also known as mini-split systems and do not require ductwork.
 
• They are suitable for individual room cooling or heating.
